items.title: Inside LACMA's Art+Film Gala With Demna's Gucci, Nicole Kidman and Eva Chow's Farewell
items.summary: WWD report on the Nov 7 LACMA Art+Film Gala, presented by Gucci for the 15th consecutive year. Demna dressed Kim Kardashian, Viola Davis, Salma Hayek Pinault and others; longtime co-chair Eva Chow announced on stage this would be her final year in the role, a notable change for Gucci's flagship US sponsorship property.

items.title: Every Must-See Look From the LACMA Art + Film Gala 2026 Red Carpet
items.summary: W Magazine red-carpet roundup of the Gucci-sponsored LACMA gala featuring custom Demna-designed Gucci gowns on Emily Ratajkowski (asymmetrical halter with high leg slit), Alex Consani and others; frames the event as a high-visibility showcase for Demna's design language beyond the runway.

items.title: Fans Are 'Disappointed' Over Mariah Carey's 'Depressing' Gucci Holiday Campaign & 'Boring' Styling
items.summary: Report compiling TikTok viewer criticism of Gucci's 2026 holiday film starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine: commenters called the tone sterile, cold and dated, with one comparing the execution to "if JCPenney was trying to be luxury" and another saying Gucci no longer feels luxe. Carey's personal styling drew some praise amid the criticism.

items.title: TikTok viewer reaction thread to Gucci x Mariah Carey holiday film
items.summary: Cluster of TikTok comments/videos reacting to Gucci's Harmony Korine-directed holiday campaign, as compiled in press coverage: creators called the ad "emotionless," "boring," and said they would be "scared" to attend the depicted party; one comment stated Gucci's monogram-heavy hardware era no longer feels luxurious. Sourced via secondary reporting since TikTok does not expose a stable aggregate post URL.

items.title: Gucci's sales drop in third quarter as weak Chinese demand dampens turnaround hopes
items.summary: Reuters-sourced report that Gucci's comparable sales fell in Q3 2026 (directly operated retail down further) with Kering shares sliding roughly 11-12% on the print; the North America market, previously a bright spot, also softened in the quarter, undercutting CEO Luca de Meo's turnaround narrative tied to Demna's new collections. Retained because today's LACMA/holiday coverage directly references this ongoing turnaround struggle.

items.title: Gucci Sales Fell 6% as Kering Raised Its Store-Closure Target to at Least 125
items.summary: Aggregator report (cross-checked against WWD/Reuters earnings coverage) noting Kering raised its 2026 net store-closure target to at least 125 after 105 net closures through nine months, with Gucci accounting for the largest share; North America logged roughly 20 net closures in H1 2026 even as it remained Gucci's most resilient regional market relative to Asia-Pacific.

items.title: "2026 Price Increase" discussion thread
items.summary: Active PurseForum thread where members report and compare newly observed Gucci price increases across US and other locations in 2026, continuing a long-running community pattern of tracking repeated price hikes; part of PurseForum's dedicated Gucci subforum which also has concurrent threads on the SS27 show and the new Flora capsule.

items.title: "Gucci SS27 Show" discussion thread
items.summary: PurseForum members discuss Demna's Spring 2027 Gucci show staged inside a mock Gucci flagship in Milan, weighing the retail-themed staging and recurring use of specific models/looks against the house's heritage codes; part of ongoing community chatter in Gucci's dedicated PurseForum subforum feeding into price-increase and quality threads.

items.title: X user reaction to Alex Consani's repeated Gucci look
items.summary: X post reacting to the Gucci SS27 show noting the dresses were glamorous but that Alex Consani's particular silhouette has recurred across nearly every one of Demna's Gucci collections, with other replies joking the look is "basically vintage Gucci" from overuse. Kept despite slightly older date as representative of ongoing X chatter about repetitive styling under Demna; flagged as lower freshness.

items.title: Kendall Jenner's cut-outs, Jared Leto's pink hair at LACMA Art+Film Gala
items.summary: Fox News celebrity recap of the Gucci-sponsored LACMA gala red carpet, covering a wide range of looks (several in Gucci) alongside non-Gucci outfits; entertainment-desk coverage illustrating how Gucci's gala sponsorship earns broad mainstream visibility beyond fashion trade press.

items.title: Gucci's Primavera Campaign Is a Fusion of K-Pop, UK Underground, DMV Rap & More
items.summary: Hypebeast coverage of Demna's star-studded Primavera FW26 campaign (Kate Moss, Tom Brady, Jin, Shawn Mendes, Xiao Zhan, Rico Nasty and others), shot by Michal Chelbin; retained only as background context for the ambassador strategy still being referenced in current LACMA/holiday coverage, acknowledged as outside the 14-day freshness window and down-weighted accordingly.
